This bundle features our signature Chicken Teriyaki, featuring tender chicken thigh glazed in a sweet and savoury homemade sauce, served over a bed of fluffy steamed rice.We’ve paired it with a warming cup of traditional Miso Soup—packed with umami flavor—and a refreshing canned drink of your choice. It’s a complete, satisfying meal designed just for you.

menu_items.name: Tokoy Date Night for 2
menu_items.description: Bring the romance of Shibuya to your sofa. Dim the lights, skip the cooking, and focus on each other with a curated Japanese feast designed for two. This set marries the best of both worlds: the rich, soul-warming comfort of our Katsu Curry and the fresh, delicate elegance of the Salmon Box.We’ve paired these mains with a golden portion of crispy JFC to share, plus two steaming Miso Soups to start the evening right. It’s the perfect way to share a taste of Tokyo—and a lovely night in.

menu_items.name: Family Feast for 4
menu_items.description: The Ultimate Family Spread. Treat the crew to a massive flavor haul. Includes two hearty Katsu Curries, a nutritious Omega 3 Salmon Box, and a premium Sushi Delight set.Includes 4 drinks to wash it all down. Whether you love crispy, spicy, or fresh—this box ticks every box.

menu_items.name: Boardroom Platter for 6
menu_items.description: Fuel your team with a premium selection. Forget the heavy sandwiches—impress your clients and colleagues with a fresh, Japanese-inspired spread that covers every dietary need.This platter features our premium Salmon Boxes for the classic seafood lover, fresh Salmon Poke Bowls for a lighter touch, and our vibrant Happy Vegan boxes for plant-based power. Served with 6 hot Miso Soups, it’s a healthy, sophisticated lunch that won't leave the room feeling heavy.
